title: ynh vendors --format json
description: Output of `ynh vendors --format json`. Bare array of supported vendor adapters with availability info. Envelope retrofit deferred.

config_dir.description: Vendor's per-project config directory under the harness root.

available.description: Whether the vendor's CLI is on PATH.

supports_resume.description: Whether the vendor's CLI can continue a previous interactive session. True for every current vendor, so it does not imply a specific session can be pinned — that additionally requires a readable local session store.
